records.title: The Optimal Mechanism in Differential Privacy
records.publication_status: arXiv v3 revised 2013; assessed this preprint version, journal-version equivalence not assessed
records.reason: Explicit optimized non-Gaussian scalar density and sampler; foundational prior art for keeping law construction open, with scalar and output-independence caveats.
records.read_scope: Primary PDF downloaded and text extracted. Read scope/model, Theorem 2 restriction, Section III density and privacy/cost assumptions, Algorithm 1, Section IV absolute-error specialization. Not a line-by-line audit of every appendix proof or discrete extension.
records.limits: Scalar optimum is not vector/FL/CIA superiority; arbitrary private parameter adaptation is not certified by fixed-parameter feasibility.

records.title: Some Constructions of Private, Efficient, and Optimal K-Norm and Elliptic Gaussian Noise

records.read_scope: Primary PMLR PDF downloaded and text extracted. Read Problems 1-3, add/remove adjacency, Section 2.1 mechanism/sensitivity/norm order definitions, Section 3.1 Sum body and sampling method, Appendix B.1 Lemmas 46-53 and Algorithm 1. locators: Appendix B.1, Lemmas 46-53 and Algorithm 1, pp. 17-20
